privacy.title: Privacy policy
paragraphs: Purpose: to handle the enquiries and quote requests you send us by phone, WhatsApp or email and, where applicable, to provide the service you hire.
Legal basis: your consent when you contact us and, if you hire us, the performance of the contract.
Retention: for as long as necessary to handle your request and meet our legal obligations.
Recipients: your data will not be shared with third parties except where required by law or with providers needed for the service (e.g. email).

Your rights: you can exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction and portability by writing to {{site.email}}. You may also lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es).
